entities.summary: Kimberley Grace "Kim" Ruddins is a retired volleyball player from the United States who won the silver medal with the United States women's national volleyball team at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles. Four years later, she represented the United States at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul. She played as a setter.
